commands.probe:
python3 -B - <<'SPRIG_CARGO_PY'
import os
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('target/restore-probe');p.mkdir()
f=p/'original';f.write_bytes(b'cargo checkpoint hardlink probe\n');f.chmod(0o640)
os.link(f,p/'hardlink');os.symlink('original',p/'symlink')
os.utime(f,ns=(1700000000123456789,1700000000123456789))
SPRIG_CARGO_PY
commands.verifyBefore:
python3 -B - <<'SPRIG_CARGO_PY'
import json,os,stat
from pathlib import Path
files=sorted(Path('target/debug/build').glob('node000-*/out/generated.rs'))
assert files, 'missing real build-script generated output'
expected='pub const BUILD_VALUE: u64 = 1;\n'
assert all(f.read_text()==expected for f in files), 'wrong generated build-script output'
assert Path('node000/build-input.txt').read_text()=='1\n'
assert os.access('target/debug/stress-app',os.X_OK)
p=Path('target/restore-probe');a=(p/'original').stat();b=(p/'hardlink').stat()
assert (a.st_dev,a.st_ino)==(b.st_dev,b.st_ino) and a.st_nlink==2
assert stat.S_IMODE(a.st_mode)==0o640 and a.st_mtime_ns==1700000000123456789
assert (p/'original').read_bytes()==b'cargo checkpoint hardlink probe\n'
assert (p/'symlink').is_symlink() and os.readlink(p/'symlink')=='original'
print(json.dumps({'ok':True,'buildValue':1,'generatedFiles':[str(f) for f in files],'hardlinkProbe':True,'exactMtime':True}))
SPRIG_CARGO_PY
